nodes.description: address payable owner; privileged address set in constructor, gates isOwner modifier
string metadataBaseUri used to build token URIs
address of the IERC721 NFT contract that is minted/burned/transferred
address of the ERC20 payment token used for pricing and payment
address receiving payments in buyWithPaymentOnly
address of coupon contract, only settable by owner
uint256 price in payment-token base units
mapping(address => mapping(uint => PreMint)) preMints queue for pre-minted payloads
mapping(address => mapping(uint => PreMint)) index-based preMint storage
mapping(address => uint) count of preMints per address
mapping(uint => PreTransfer) pre-authorized NFT transfers keyed by tokenId
mapping(uint => mapping(uint => PreTransfer)) indexed preTransfer storage
mapping(uint => uint) count of preTransfers per tokenId
uint256 _status reentrancy lock from ReentrancyGuard (_NOT_ENTERED/_ENTERED)
constructor: sets owner=msg.sender, config addresses, price = _price * 10**decimals
transferOwnership(address payable newOwner) public isOwner: reassigns owner
getOwner() external view returns owner
claim(uint256 tokenId) public isOwner: burns NFT through external IERC721 call
buyWithPaymentOnly(address _to,uint256 _tokenId,string image) payable: verifies image hash, pulls ERC20 payment, mints NFT, cleans preMint state
addPreMint(address _for,string _payload,uint256 _tokenId,bytes32 preImage) public isOwner: registers a preMint
_duplicatePremint(address,uint256) internal view: duplicate detection helper
deletePreMint(address _for,uint256 _tokenId) public isOwner: removes preMint state
transferWithCode(uint256 _tokenId,string code) payable: verifies code hash then transfers NFT from preTransfer._from to msg.sender without reentrancy guard
addPreTransfer(uint256 _tokenId,bytes32 preImage) public: anyone can register a preTransfer with themselves as _from
_duplicatePretransfer(uint256) internal view: duplicate detection helper
deletePreTransfer(uint256 _tokenId) public isOwner: removes preTransfer state
changeMetadataBaseUri(string) public isOwner: updates metadata base URI
transferNftOwnership(address) external isOwner: calls external Ownable.transferOwnership on nftAddress
mint(address,uint256,string,string) external isOwner: forwards mint to NFT contract
changeName(string,string) external isOwner: forwards name/symbol change to NFT contract
updateTokenUri(uint256,string) external isOwner: forwards URI update to NFT contract
getPaymentDecimals() public view: reads decimals from payment token
changePayment(address) public isOwner: updates paymentAddress
changeRecipient(address) public isOwner: updates recipientAddress
changeNft(address) public isOwner: updates nftAddress
changePrice(uint256 _price) public isOwner: recomputes price = _price * 10 ** decimals
concat(string,string) internal pure string helper
uintToStr(uint) internal pure conversion helper
nonReentrant modifier: sets _status to _ENTERED and back to _NOT_ENTERED; not applied to buyWithPaymentOnly/transferWithCode
msg.sender: caller address used for owner checks, mapping keys, payment source and NFT recipient
external call IERC721(nftAddress).burn(tokenId) in claim
external call paymentToken.transferFrom(msg.sender, recipientAddress, price) in buyWithPaymentOnly before state cleanup
external call nftToken.mint(_to,_tokenId,_uri,payload) in buyWithPaymentOnly after payment
external call nftToken.transferFrom(preTransfer._from,msg.sender,_tokenId) in transferWithCode before delete of preTransfers state
unchecked multiplication _price * 10 ** decimals in constructor and changePrice
external call Ownable(nftAddress).transferOwnership(newOwner) in transferNftOwnership
address _to: NFT mint recipient in buyWithPaymentOnly
uint256 _tokenId: preMint key and minted token id in buyWithPaymentOnly
string image: hashed with sha256 and compared to stored preImage
uint256 _price: human price scaled by 10**decimals in changePrice
uint256 tokenId: NFT burned by owner in claim
address payable newOwner: new privileged owner
uint256 _tokenId: preTransfer key in transferWithCode
string code: hashed and compared to preTransfer.preImage
PreMint memory preMint loaded from preMints[msg.sender][_tokenId]
IERC20Token paymentToken = IERC20Token(paymentAddress)
IERC721 nftToken = IERC721(nftAddress)
uint decimals read from BasicERC20(paymentAddress).decimals()
PreTransfer memory preTransfer loaded from preTransfers[_tokenId]
IERC721 nftToken = IERC721(nftAddress) in transferWithCode

normalization_plan.reason: address _to is only consumed by the mint call inside buyWithPaymentOnly; fold the parameter into its enclosing entry-point function
uint256 _tokenId is only used as a preMints/preMintsByIndex key inside buyWithPaymentOnly
string image feeds sha256 validation that gates buyWithPaymentOnly; it has no standalone semantic identity
uint256 _price is the operand of the unchecked multiplication price = _price * 10 ** decimals, so merge it into that unsafe arithmetic operation
uint256 tokenId is only used to invoke the external burn inside claim
address payable newOwner is directly assigned to the owner state variable inside transferOwnership
uint256 _tokenId indexes preTransfers and preTransferCounts inside transferWithCode
string code is only hashed for the preImage comparison that authorizes transferWithCode
